subject.name: Guru Benchmark
subject.description: The public Guru Benchmark repository, including its contracts, deterministic evaluator, renderer, CLI, expert-lens corpus, tests, and repository-local workflow evidence.

decision.question: Is the repository ready to produce a reproducible public-safe verdict with complete founding-council coverage, and what remains before release?

operating_environment.scale: One local version-pinned evaluation at a time
operating_environment.lifecycle: Public open-source repository maintained through repository-local tasks and gates

constraints.statement: Validation and rendering must complete without network access.
Published output must not contain private data, impersonation, fabricated quotations, or unsupported attribution.
Benchmark, context, lenses, sources, and outputs must use immutable exact versions.

assumptions: The repository-local fixtures and exact lens snapshots remain available with the evaluated commit.
